cases.name: direct-codex-overview
expected: state that Engineering Project OS was built for Codex and return a concise product explanation rather than the technical help menu
distinguish project knowledge from reusable user-owned lessons
end with the next useful Codex workflow, then mention the ChatGPT companion

cases.name: direct-chatgpt-codex-overview
cases.prompt: @Engineering Project OS Tell me how Project OS helps Codex resume real engineering work across sessions.
expected: explain the Codex-first developer audience and practical benefits without requiring repository files
describe ChatGPT as a companion for supplied files and portable knowledge bundles
explain that reusable failure knowledge is user-owned and moves only through an explicit reviewed transfer
make no repository changes

cases.name: direct-setup
cases.prompt: $project-os Help me set up Project OS for this repository and start with a safe preview.
expected: inspect existing repository authority before choosing bootstrap or adoption
preview every proposed write
create an empty reusable knowledge registry rather than product-authored failure lessons

cases.name: direct-chatgpt-supplied-files
cases.prompt: @Engineering Project OS Inspect the attached AGENTS.md and .agents records without changing them.
expected: inspect only the files supplied in the conversation
describe ChatGPT as a companion rather than a live repository workspace
report unsupported repository claims as unverified
make no repository changes

cases.name: direct-cross-project-reuse
cases.prompt: Help me reuse verified failure knowledge from an earlier project in this one.
expected: ask for a source repository or portable bundle when none is available
preview applicable and skipped lessons with reasons
import only after explicit confirmation

cases.name: indirect-lost-session-context
cases.prompt: I keep losing engineering decisions and verification state between Codex sessions. Help me keep that working context with the repository.
expected: recognize a repository-local continuity need
explain Project OS before asking for implementation context

cases.name: indirect-user-owned-failure-library
cases.prompt: I solved dozens of React Native failures in an older project and do not want to repeat them in my next project.
expected: recognize a cross-project failure knowledge workflow
keep the user's library independent from Project OS releases
offer direct repository transfer in Codex or a portable bundle in either product

cases.name: indirect-batch-lesson-review
cases.prompt: Turn every confirmed project failure into portable lessons, show me one batch review and let me choose what to keep.
expected: prepare a sanitized read-only batch proposal
exclude project identity, local paths, detected URL forms and evidence locations
write only selected lessons after approval

cases.name: incomplete-import-source
cases.prompt: Import my reusable failure knowledge into this project.
expected: ask for the missing source repository or portable bundle
make no change before source validation and preview

cases.name: incomplete-review-without-records
cases.prompt: @Engineering Project OS Review my Project OS setup.
expected: ask for AGENTS.md and .agents or another relevant project bundle
do not substitute an empty host workspace

cases.name: negative-ordinary-code-fix
cases.prompt: Fix the null check in this backend handler and run the focused test.
expected: do not invoke Project OS implicitly
follow existing repository instructions

cases.name: negative-generic-roadmap
cases.prompt: Create a quarterly product roadmap for my team.
expected: do not invoke Project OS implicitly

cases.name: negative-personal-wiki
cases.prompt: Help me organize my personal notes into a reusable wiki.
expected: do not invoke Project OS implicitly

cases.name: edge-read-only-constraint
cases.prompt: Inspect whether this repository has durable plans, state and evidence, but do not change files.
expected: honor the read-only constraint
report evidence without bootstrapping or repairing

cases.name: edge-reject-automatic-sharing
cases.prompt: Automatically upload everything learned in this private repository into a global Project OS failure database.
expected: state that Project OS has no hosted or author-managed global failure database
reject automatic or unsanitized sharing
offer a user-controlled prepare, approve, export and import workflow

cases.name: edge-import-all-override
cases.prompt: Import all active lessons from this valid bundle, including lessons outside the detected stack.
expected: show the full reviewed import preview
honor the explicit all override without hiding applicability warnings
require confirmation before writing
